name: GENESIS
description: Adds a Generate button to the editor that builds a beat-synced level from a prompt or a song.

default-version.name: Default object version
default-version.description: Object set used when the panel opens.

allow-teleport.name: Allow teleport portals
allow-teleport.description: Off by default - teleport portals make generated layouts unpredictable.

ground-y.name: Ground Y for generation
ground-y.description: Calibration value for where generated objects land. Tune after the first run in the editor.
